title: ReStage：可再执行的演出空间
summary: ReStage 长期研究提案：以空间影像、声学测量、时间与状态数据，探索一次实时演出如何被保存、重建并再次执行；规范、验证和跨平台实现仍在研究中。
summaryEn: A long-term research proposal for capturing and re-executing performance space through visual, acoustic, temporal, and state data. Implementation and cross-platform validation remain research goals.

editorial.note: A research specification and roadmap, not a completed reproducible publication.
